name: Bens Bash
description:
Training ride open to all. The aim of these rides is to provide a regular training ride for all to join in, riding at a steady pace that for some will feel challenging but over time you will get fitter and more comfortable.

Be mindful of your pace and try to keep the group together rather than just ride off on your own - look at this as a way to improve your fitness as well as pick up some skills around riding with others. 

Try not to ride over 3.5 w/kg but if you are feeling frisky - feel free to open the taps with 10 mins to go. 

We will vary the routes so check back regularly.

name: The XP Express - Run
description: All aboard The XP Express! We're dishing out Double XP in this event so sign up, lace up your shoes and get ready to Level Up. The XP Express is the "super shoe" of Zwift running, where every stride counts twice. Whether you're starting your Zwift journey or a seasoned pro, hop aboard to Level Up your run. How does it work? The XP Express events will double your XP, helping you wrack up 80XP per kilometer or 120XP per mile! Leveling Up is the perfect way to unlock new swag, and of course some bragging rights. Use this event as an easy recovery run, a quick warm up before your next race or push yourself to the limit to see how much XP you can earn.

name: SISU World Cup - Game 4
description:
SISU Racing Launches the SISU World Game

The world will come together for football’s greatest spectacle this year — and now the world of cycling esports has its own global showdown.

Welcome to the SISU World Game.

Inspired by the spirit, passion and national pride of the FIFA World Cup, SISU Racing is proud to announce a brand-new international racing concept where every pedal stroke counts for your country.
Across four action-packed “Games”, riders won’t just race for individual glory — they’ll race for national pride.

In a unique twist, the winning rider’s country in each grade will claim victory for that stage, while the overall General Classification (GC) winners will determine the ultimate champion nations of the SISU World Game.

It’s a celebration of what makes SISU Racing special: global connection, fierce competition, and a community built from every corner of the world.

From Finland to Australia. From Canada to Denmark. From Belgium to the USA. From the UK to Poland.
One world. One start line.

And in true SISU fashion, the routes have been selected to test every type of rider — punchers, climbers, diesel engines, technical racers and tactical masterminds.

For more information and results see sisu.racing/worldcup

The Games

Game 1
Tuesday 9 June
Cobbles Crown – Richmond
The SISU World Game begins on the punchy cobbles of Richmond. Short climbs, rolling terrain and technical rhythm changes will demand explosive power and sharp race IQ. Positioning will be everything as nations battle for the first jersey and first bragging rights of the series.

Game 2
Tuesday 16 June
2018 UCI Worlds Short Lap – Innsbruck
A nod to one of cycling’s most iconic World Championship venues. Innsbruck delivers relentless climbing pressure and rewards riders who can suffer deep and keep pushing. Pure climbers and punchy all-rounders will smell opportunity here.

Game 3
Tuesday 23 June
Spinfinity – New York
Fast. Aggressive. Unpredictable.
New York’s futuristic roads bring high-speed racing with constant elevation changes and no room to hide. Expect attacks, counterattacks and nations fighting desperately for every second as the SISU World Game reaches its critical phase.

Game 4
Tuesday 30 June
Green to Screen – New York
The final Game promises fireworks.
Green to Screen is one of Zwift’s most demanding modern routes — beginning with fast flowing terrain before rising into a brutal uphill finale. This is where legends will be made, GC battles settled, and one nation crowned champion of the SISU World Game.

The SISU World Cup is another example of SISU Racing continuing to innovate within cycling esports.
This isn’t just about watts. It’s about identity, community and bringing riders together through the universal language of sport.

Every nation has a story. Every rider has a role to play.
And somewhere, one country will rise above the rest.
The world stage is waiting.
Let’s go racing!

name: Pride On with LGBTQ Zwifters
description:
LGBTQ Zwifters invite you to ride or race with us during Pride month in support of the LGBTQIA+ community.

Let’s clip in, turn up the colours, and roll out together! This Pride On social ride is all about togetherness - one big, joyful bunch cruising the roads where everyone belongs. No surges, no stress, no getting left behind. You can expect steady spins, good vibes, and plenty of chat as rainbow jerseys fill the screen. Whether you’re here to celebrate, support, or simply enjoy a relaxed ride with an amazing community, this is your space. Ride proud, ride together, and let’s make the miles brighter.


All Pride month events

Group rides:
Most rides will be community-led and rubberbanded (E cat) unless specified by the event pace category.

name: The XP Express with Good Time Riders GTR
description:
All aboard The XP Express!

We're dishing out Double XP in this event so sign up, kit up and get ready to Level Up.

The XP Express is a turbocharged ride where every pedal stroke counts twice. Whether you're starting your Zwift journey or a seasoned pro, hop aboard to Level Up your ride.

How does it work?
The XP Express events will double your XP, helping you wrack up 40XP per kilometer or 64XP per mile! Leveling Up is the perfect way to unlock new swag, access to bikes and wheels, new routes and, of course, some bragging rights.

Use this event as an easy recovery ride, a quick warm up before your next race or push yourself to the limit to see how much XP you can earn.

name: ATTAQUER SWARM RIDES ON ZWIFT
description:
Attaquer is bringing its IRL SWARM rides to Zwift as a weekly series built around community, consistency and riding together. What started as social group rides out on the road now continues indoors, giving more riders the chance to be part of it wherever they are.

SWARM rides are simple. No racing, no pressure. Just rolling turns, steady effort and a group that sticks together. Everyone is welcome, whether you are new to Zwift or ride every day.

Complete any SWARM ride in the series and you will unlock the exclusive Attaquer kit in-game.

Find out more about the series here: https://attaquercycling.com/pages/zwift 

--------------------------

WEEKLY RIDES: TWO SESSIONS. EVERY TUESDAY

We run two social spins every Tuesday across different Zwift courses. One for early risers, one for the after work crew. Pick your slot, plug in, and SWARM up.

Each ride is 45 minutes at a social pace, on a different course each week, and open to all levels.

--------------------------

Tuesday Morning
6:30 AM AEST
SWARM Morning Ride

Start the day right. 45 minutes of social riding on a different Zwift course each week. The pace is steady and the group stays together, so you will be done before most people have had breakfast.

--------------------------

Tuesday Arvo
5:00 PM AEST
SWARM Arvo Ride


The best commute you will ever do. 45 minutes of social riding to shake off the day. New roads each week, same crew rolling together from start to finish.

name: Stage 5: Level Up Racing: Queen's Highway After Party
description:
Level Up Racing is June’s ZRacing monthly series. Race across five stages from June 1 to July 5, with a new route each week and up to 250 XP waiting at every banner. Complete stages to build series progress, chase the GC leaderboard, and grab bonus XP as you race.

Stage 5

Dates: June 29–July 5
Route: Queen’s Highway After Party
Laps: 1
Distance: 19.8 km
Elevation: 301 m

The series wraps with Queen’s Highway After Party, a single-lap finale with the biggest elevation total of the month. One last chance to race, earn bonus XP, and finish June strong.

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The Monthly GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/zracingjun2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Team Italy Coffee Italian Ride
description:
Se cerchi la giusta compagnia per prepararti al fine settimana sei nel posto giusto.
Lo scopo della COFFEE ITALIAN RIDE è quello di stare tutti insieme, sfruttare la scia del gruppo e fare due chiacchiere al ritmo medio di 2.0 w/kg per 60 minuti, il late join è attivo per 30 minuti.
Questa NON è una gara.
Segui le istruzioni dei leader(giallo) per un gruppo compatto.
Ricordati di non superare la fence (barra rossa) altrimenti verrai eliminato.
Partecipa a questa ride per sbloccare la divisa del team italy.
BUONA PEDALATA A TUTTI
TEAM ITALY organizza una vasta gamma di eventi, tutti con le seguenti regole:
-in una pedalata di categoria D, alcuni ciclisti sono principianti, segui le istruzioni del
leader (logo giallo) che appaiono come testo al centro e tieni presente che il ritmo sarà di
circa 2 wkg
-Il valore WKG sarà diverso per tutti voi, il motivo principale sarà il peso, seguito dalla
capacità di utilizzare la scia e l'equipaggiamento della vostra bici in gioco
-abilitare i messaggi nelle opzioni zwift, fondamentali per una buona esperienza
-le pedalate della categoria D sono facili per un ciclista con C alto, 3wkg ftp, impegnative per un C basso, 2.5 wkg ftp, estreme per un ciclista D con 2 wkg FTP, lo stesso per le
corse C, facili per un A, 4wkg ftp, impegnative per B 3.2 wkg ftp, ed estreme per C con 2.5
wkg ftp.


Are you looking for the perfect companion and you are training for the weekend? This is the right place.
Coffee Italian Ride's goal is to stay together, enjoy the group draft and a bit of easy chat at 2.0 w/kg for 90 minutes, late join is enabled for 30 minutes.
This is NOT A RACE.
Follow the leaders' instructions (yellow beacons) for keeping the group tight.
Remember the Fence is KILLER, 60 seconds over and you'll be out of the event.
Join this ride to unlock the Team Italy Jersey.
TEAM ITALY organizes a wide range of events, all agreed to the following rules:
- into a D category ride, some riders are beginners, follow the leader instructions (yellow
beacon) that appear as text in the middle and keep in mind that the pace will be around 2
wkg
-WKG value will be different for all of you, the main reason will be weight, followed by the
capacity to use the draft and your ingame bike equipment
- enable the messages into zwift options, fundamental for a great experience
- D category's ride are easy for a high C rider, 3wkg ftp, challenging for a low C, 2.5 wkg
ftp, extreme for a D rider with 2 wkg FTP, same for C rides, easy for an A, 4 wkg ftp,
challenging for B's, 3.2 wkg ftp and extreme for C's 2.5 wkg ftp.
- if you have any suggestions please let us know
#TeamItaly #JerseyUnlock #respect4leader

name: Velos Sunny Side Up
description:
Time flies when you are having fun, but this is not a race, we just want to enjoy your company. Come and join team Velos for a D paced beginner friendly social spin for 60 minutes. Please pace with the yellow beacon at 1.5 - 1.8 w/kg. It’s a group ride so we encourage lots of chatter, maybe test you with some trivia questions and give you the opportunity to show off your pacing skills. Shout outs are given to those who catch the eye of the yellow beacon for riding close. Our supportive red beacon team will help any riders who drop behind to pace back to the yellow beacon if requested. Feel free to join in with the on screen chat, test your legs on a sprint or two or drop and help sweep at the back if your legs are strong. The fence may be used to encourage riders to work together and maximise the draft. Late join is available within the first 30 minutes and a Velos jersey is yours to keep if you complete the ride. We start and finish as a group and encourage all riders to look out for each other.

Come and try out Team Velos today and then be sure to see what other rides we host throughout the week. There is something for everybody and we guarantee a warm welcome.

Join Team Velos at. teamvelos.co.uk

Discord Channel. https://discord.gg/TDBE3FA

name: Ascenders Banded Brunch Bunch Ride
description:
Welcome to [ASC] - Ascenders Brunch Bunch for a chilled Rubber Banded ride around the virtual roads of Zwift.  Each week the course will vary so whether you’re a beginner just starting out on your first group rides, this is a great way to start. If recovering from injury, or just looking for a steady paced ride then come and join us. We aim to provide a safe encouraging ride for you to enjoy. You’ll be very welcome in the Brunch Bunch


This is a banded group ride and not a race. As long as you keep spinning you will stay with the group. If you’re looking for an easy ride then sit in the group near the Yellow Lead Beacon. However if you’re feeling strong then head to the front and help pull the group along.


Please note this ride is not fenced.

name: Run 10K Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the longest running daily led running event on Zwift. This was the event that kickstarted the NoblePro Running Club in support of a world record attempt at consecutive daily10k runs.
The event has a healthy group of leaders who are friendly and chatty and will help you achieve your goal, not matter your experience. Feel free to join in the chat and become addicted like we all are.

Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it's not a race.
If you don't want to run 10k then come along for as long as you wish, the support is always appreciated.
The event runs at the same time each day, each day of the week there is a different course.

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.

name: Heffron Handicap
description:
Heffron Handicap

Heffron is widely regarded as the hardest regular handicap in Australia. The quality of riders, the technical course, the history and the handicap format make Heffron the legendary race that it is. As the saying goes, “if you can win at Heffron, you can win anywhere”.

Like every Heffron, expect a blistering start, followed by settling into an uncomfortably hard rhythm and watching the other grades in the last few minutes, hoping yours is the one that takes the win. Solo or mini break a few km’s from the line or an all-out sprint with 400m to go? That’s the age-old question that Heffron asks every race. The answer? Well, that changes too often to know. Win and you can say you’ve won Heffron – and know that if you win at Heffron, you can win anywhere. Get it wrong and all you’ll be left with are the “I could have won, if only” stories we tell our mates the next day. In the end, there can only be one Heffron winner.

name: AusCycling Talent Identification
description:
Your journey to the top step starts in your living room.

AusCycling invites you to test yourself against the best. The workout comprises three free ride efforts: 15 seconds, 3 minutes and 12 minutes designed to test your critical power. As with any test or race, ensure you are appropriately warmed up and motivated.

The test is short and sharp, requiring maximum commitment. Erg mode will be turned off during the intervals, you are on your own and its your time to shine.

As you fade through the efforts, use your gears to reduce the resistance and maintain your cadence. Aiming for 90-100rpm for the efforts. Finish the efforts completely spent, the key is to finish all the efforts regardless of how much your power fades or how hard it feels.

Saddle up and enjoy the ride!

 Target Audience;
 16-22yo with no high-performance sport background
 People with vision or physical impairment – any age

People with background in high-performance sport – any age
*If you are outside the ages of 16-22 and have a background in high performance sport or vision/physical impairment please visit https://www.auscycling.org.au/page/virtual-tid and contact us for more information.

name: Orange Unicorn Lite
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Making workouts less monotonous and fun is a crucial aspect of indoor training. Over/unders is an excellent way to accomplish this. Today's workout is an efficient workout to help boost our threshold power. After a warm-up, we'll go into 2 sets of 6x (2min under and 30sec over), then cool down. You got this!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Shayne Gaffney (GC Coaching) holds a bachelors degree in Health Science in Professional Development and Advanced Patient Care, is a USA Cycling Level 1 (expert level) Certified Coach, a level 2 certified Training Peaks coach, a USA Cycling certified power based training coach, USA Olympic Committee Safe Sport Certified, and a licensed physical therapist assistant.  He is also the creator of Zwift's "Build Me Up" Flexible Training Plan.  He can be contacted directly via  for any cycling or training related questions.

For more information on GC Coaching, please visit www.gaffneycyclingcoaching.com

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

HELPFUL HINT

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. 

For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: RCC Global Club Ride
description:
WELCOME TO THE RAPHA CYCLING CLUB WORLD WIDE GROUP RIDE. 
 
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us. 
We host 4 rides every week on a Tuesday to suit different time zones around the world (aimed at evenings), join whichever time works best for you. 
 
WHO IS THE RCC?
 
The Rapha Cycling Club (RCC) is, as the name suggests, Rapha’s Cycling Club. The RCC exists to help connect like minded riders from all over the world, underpinned by Rapha’s products and experiences. We ride together across continents and here united within Zwift. 
 
For more information head to: www.Rapha.cc/rcc
 
RIDE LEADERS
 
The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders from around the world.  The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. Prompts will appear on screen set by the workout designer Matt Rowe so you know what to do throughout the ride. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app. 
 
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS
 
Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.
 
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Today's workout contains 4 x 6 minute blocks of Zone 3, with some surges thrown in for good measure! The Zone 3 riding should feel nice and comfortable, however the surges may sting a little. The surges in each block are only 20 seconds long, but at 110% of FTP so require a focused increase in effort .At the end of each 6 minute block, there is a 1 minute 'Free Ride' - this is your chance to turn an endurance based session into something special! Come event day or when riding with friends, it's likely you want some more power for that final sprint to the cafe right? Give it 100% in each 60 second Free Ride section to help you become more explosive! Stress points 45: #Social
 
 
WORKOUT DESIGNER
 
Matt Rowe is the founder of Rowe & King Coaching (www.roweandking.com) with 25 years of cycling experience, coaching amateur cyclists all over the world to  achieve their personal goals.
 
HELPFUL HINT
 
We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.
You can adjust the difficulty of the workout mid-ride if needed, by using the up/down arrows on the left hand side, under the workout details.
 
HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

ABOUT ONGOING TRAINING
Every week we drop a fresh, coach-built workout designed to fit naturally into an athlete’s real training rhythm. These aren’t static repeats. Sessions ebb and flow with the broader race season, shifting from early-season durability to midseason sharpening and late-season precision.

name: Film My Run 500 with NoblePro
description:
Join Stephen Cousins and NoblePro for a 500 metre climb. Set your treadmill to 12% incline and run 4.2km of distance to reach 500 metres elevation. If your treadmill doesn't go that high, set it as high as it will go and join us anyway!

The run will be progressive starting at a walking pace of 5kph rising to 7kph for the final kilometre. Get on to the balls of your toes and get your calf muscles to do the work. This continuous uphill effort will help build strength and endurance for those hilly trail runs

This event is sponsored by the ever popular Noble Pro treadmills. You can get a discount on a NoblePro SMART treadmill from this link https://zwift.run/noble-pro

You can watch the run on the live stream at http://youtube.com/ZwiftRunChannel

It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

name: All American Bikes Ride presented by GRIT
description:
This is NOT a race, the ride will start with a warmup pace of 2.5 w/kg for all riders Yes, both A and B groups start together and stay together at the beginning! On flat sections near the start of the ride, we want both groups to stay together with a casual pace.

Join us for this social group ride. Our route will be a combination of flat sections and some big hills. The route will be selected to have 2 or 3 large hills during the ride.
Group A: Please join group A if you can maintain above 4.0 w/kg on short climbs.
Group B will be going uphill at 3.5 - 4.0 w/kg.
We want to increase the size of Group A. Please join group A if you are a strong group B rider. We want Group B to be riders that prefer 3.5 - 4.0 w/kg on climbs.
After hills, we will maintain 2 main groups. Group A riders that are in front of the group A leader should slow to rejoin the leader. Group B riders in front of the group B leader should slow to rejoin the leader. We ask for your cooperation to rejoin with your group to make this a fun social ride.

We welcome you to challenge yourself and join this ride even if you don't typically ride at this level. We often find riders join us and find that they can handle a higher intensity level by riding with a faster group.

GRIT: Great Rides for Intense Training

name: CRYO-GEN Power Tuesday Group Ride
description:
Power Tuesday. The TGR Ride is a ride that has been organized for the many riders in the Zwift Community who wish to have a paced ride with friends and like-minded members of the community. The ride has been organised as a workout ride and will incorporate intervals.
 
If you are a stronger rider who has joined the group to possibly support others or to support a friend you can help the group Leader and others by watching the back of the group for any rider struggling to stay with the main group and assist if needed.

These events are held to assist with the attainment of your training goals and will include intervals over and below the ride average parameters. This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the sweeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. 

The pace will be kept at a manageable level to attempt to have all riders finish together. 
We will endeavor to have as many Sweepers as possible to assist any rider who is struggling.

There are no rules apart from enjoy the ride and try not to ride ahead of the group leader.

HEALTH: We would advise any rider who is attempting a Zwift ride for the first time to, ensure that their health should always take precedence over completing any ride. If you feel unwell or unable to continue please STOP 
NOTE: Exercise contributes to 25% weight loss; Healthy Eating (Not Diet) contributes to the other 75%. Be fit and Healthy.

description:
Wake Up North America!!!
It’s time for a good early morning or lunchtime stretch ride brought to you by the friendly folks at Vikings and Team Valhalla.
Our fat burn, “no drop” ride is totally unique to Zwift……2 great paces making 1 amazing ride.
Feeling energetic? Then ride with the Yellow beacon at 1.8-2.5 w/kg. Feel like taking it down a bit? Then ride with the Red beacon at 1.6-1.8 w/kg. Feel like chasing? Then bounce back and forth between Yellow and Red. Everybody is included in our hour-long party.

name: GGCC Glasgow Green Cycle Club Tuesday Training Ride
description:
This GGCC group ride is a TRAINING event, category D, with a yellow beacon leader. The beacon leader will ride between 1.5 and 2.5w/kg pace average wherever possible.

Please look out for our 4 training rides a week, every week - Tuesday’s D-ride at 11.00am and C-ride 20.45 UTC; Thursday’s C-ride at 21.00 UTC; and Saturday’s C-ride at 11.30am UTC. Use #ggcc to search for all our events, as in https://zwift.com/events/tag/ggcc

The Glasgow Green Cycle Club (GGCC) training rides are intended to provide a challenge for riders. You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the beacon ride leader(s) for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. Some group rides also have a short closing minirace, to start from behind the beacon.

GGCC is a Glasgow based cycling club whose “in real life” (irl) club runs and training rides are always organized into pace groups, which match the Zwift categories quite well. GGCC also has a good race pedigree and presence in Scotland, and so we have created this training ride series to suit what we believe is relevant to any bike riders’ interests in performance and improvement in our own club, and elsewhere. 

Racers will, no doubt, aspire to try our other events: races on Mondays at  20.10 UTC, and 3 TTs on Fridays at 18.45, 19.15 and 19.45 UTC. 

Also look out for our 6Points Mallorca rides and races - Monday’s race at 20.10 UTC, Tuesday’s group D-ride at 09.55 UTC, and Sunday’s group C-ride at 11.40am UTC. Search for 6Points events at https://zwift.com/events/tag/6points.

As we expect our club’s riders to be able to ride 50 miles at a 15mph average on our Sunday rides, such steady riding members will be comfortable with Zwift Category D, or, for a challenge, Category C. In our various rides we cater for all abilities, through the Zwift ABCD levels. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift messaging (always) and/or Discord (sometimes) to vary the pace to allow for sprints and intervals, with regrouping after each segment, and sometimes a short optional closing mini-race to finish the ride the rides,. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and intervals.

Results can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we will, in common with many other ride series, publish your results on zwiftpower.com too.

All bikes and PUs are allowed, but it’s better not to use TT bikes (which don’t draft) on our group rides and races. Please add GGCC (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognized, where X is your desired ride category. Categories are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg, then pick the correct ride and group. This ride is categorized as:

D: 1.5 W/kg to 2.5 W/kg FTP; the beacon leader will ride to 2w/kg pace average.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.
You can use our Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/UDhdEQA

For more about specific Zwift courses for our events, see the Zwift Companion schedule, and also https://zwiftinsider.com/ where there is a wealth of information about all things Zwift.

Please see the GGCC Zwift page link at http://www.glasgowgreencycleclub.co.uk/ for more.

#ggcc

All aboard The XP Express!

We're dishing out Double XP in this event so sign up, kit up and get ready to Level Up.

The XP Express is a turbocharged ride where every pedal stroke counts twice. Whether you're starting your Zwift journey or a seasoned pro, hop aboard to Level Up your ride.

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: SISU World Cup - Game 4
description:
SISU Racing Launches the SISU World Game

The world will come together for football’s greatest spectacle this year — and now the world of cycling esports has its own global showdown.

Welcome to the SISU World Game.

Inspired by the spirit, passion and national pride of the FIFA World Cup, SISU Racing is proud to announce a brand-new international racing concept where every pedal stroke counts for your country.
Across four action-packed “Games”, riders won’t just race for individual glory — they’ll race for national pride.

In a unique twist, the winning rider’s country in each grade will claim victory for that stage, while the overall General Classification (GC) winners will determine the ultimate champion nations of the SISU World Game.

It’s a celebration of what makes SISU Racing special: global connection, fierce competition, and a community built from every corner of the world.

From Finland to Australia. From Canada to Denmark. From Belgium to the USA. From the UK to Poland.
One world. One start line.

And in true SISU fashion, the routes have been selected to test every type of rider — punchers, climbers, diesel engines, technical racers and tactical masterminds.

For more information and results see sisu.racing/worldcup

The Games

Game 1
Tuesday 9 June
Cobbles Crown – Richmond
The SISU World Game begins on the punchy cobbles of Richmond. Short climbs, rolling terrain and technical rhythm changes will demand explosive power and sharp race IQ. Positioning will be everything as nations battle for the first jersey and first bragging rights of the series.

Game 2
Tuesday 16 June
2018 UCI Worlds Short Lap – Innsbruck
A nod to one of cycling’s most iconic World Championship venues. Innsbruck delivers relentless climbing pressure and rewards riders who can suffer deep and keep pushing. Pure climbers and punchy all-rounders will smell opportunity here.

Game 3
Tuesday 23 June
Spinfinity – New York
Fast. Aggressive. Unpredictable.
New York’s futuristic roads bring high-speed racing with constant elevation changes and no room to hide. Expect attacks, counterattacks and nations fighting desperately for every second as the SISU World Game reaches its critical phase.

Game 4
Tuesday 30 June
Green to Screen – New York
The final Game promises fireworks.
Green to Screen is one of Zwift’s most demanding modern routes — beginning with fast flowing terrain before rising into a brutal uphill finale. This is where legends will be made, GC battles settled, and one nation crowned champion of the SISU World Game.

The SISU World Cup is another example of SISU Racing continuing to innovate within cycling esports.
This isn’t just about watts. It’s about identity, community and bringing riders together through the universal language of sport.

Every nation has a story. Every rider has a role to play.
And somewhere, one country will rise above the rest.
The world stage is waiting.
Let’s go racing!

name: DWGZ Endurance – Who Let the DWGZ Out?!
description:
Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build emotional endurance, community strength, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Our Tuesday Endurance Ride is a punchy, higher-energy endurance session — typically (but not always) featuring a KOM climb segment, steady pressure, and the signature DWGZ vibe: gritty, supportive, and full of good watts and better banter.

Whether you’re pushing for fitness gains, sharpening your endurance, or rolling with a community that makes suffering fun, this ride is for you.

Ride Categories

🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg

🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg

🚴 D Category – 1.5–2.5 w/kg

Expect consistent pacing, a punchy segment(s), and a crew that brings the best energy on Zwift. From the beacon to our sweep team, every part of the ride is built on teamwork, grit, and connection.

DWGZ rides run Monday through Saturday at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.

Clip in, dig in, and bring the good energy - DWGZ: Get Gritty!

About DIRT

Team DIRT is an acronym for Dads Inside Riding Trainers — a community that has grown to include like-minded moms and dads who balance training with work and family life. A global tribe with a great vibe that makes you want to ride, DIRT is built on connection, encouragement, and fitting fitness into real life.

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/sUnwqPZ

And on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZWIFTDIRT

name: Stage 5: Level Up Racing: Queen's Highway After Party
description:
Level Up Racing is June’s ZRacing monthly series. Race across five stages from June 1 to July 5, with a new route each week and up to 250 XP waiting at every banner. Complete stages to build series progress, chase the GC leaderboard, and grab bonus XP as you race.

Stage 5

Dates: June 29–July 5
Route: Queen’s Highway After Party
Laps: 1
Distance: 19.8 km
Elevation: 301 m

The series wraps with Queen’s Highway After Party, a single-lap finale with the biggest elevation total of the month. One last chance to race, earn bonus XP, and finish June strong.

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The Monthly GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/zracingjun2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh


ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

description:
ABOUT ONGOING TRAINING
Every week we drop a fresh, coach-built workout designed to fit naturally into an athlete’s real training rhythm. These aren’t static repeats. Sessions ebb and flow with the broader race season, shifting from early-season durability to midseason sharpening and late-season precision.

Dave leads most sessions and designs each workout to support athletes who want structure, accountability, and high quality training that complements their real world goals.

Let’s ride away the stigma!

The Ride For Mental Health (TRFMH) was started to support a community dedicated to eliminating the stigma of mental illness through education and open conversation.

name: Escape Collective Tuesday Escapade
description:
Welcome to the Escape Collective Tuesday Escapade group ride, brought to you by friends of the Escape Collective (escapecollective.cc). It’s the same crew and ride format formerly known as “The Placeholder Tuesday Group Ride”.

This is a fun social group ride with the aim of enjoying riding in the bunch and having a bit of banter all with a touch of (optional) friendly competition.

Ride with our playlist, just search for “Escape Collective Zwift Playlist” on Spotify. Hit Play as the ride starts and enjoy the tunes.

Come along and ride with the crew where our ride leader will set a pace of up to 2.5w/kg after a slower warmup. Our course varies each week and most weeks will be a flat route to help keep the bunch together. Each ride will have a sweeper with a few other riders who are available to help any riders come back to the group if asked for assistance.

This is a social group ride not a race, so please respect the pace set by the ride leader. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) and the sweeper beacon (red) to stay in the blob - flat, hilly or in between!

To keep things interesting, we offer optional opportunities for a sprint each lap followed by a regroup. Depending on the week we have 2 different ride formats:

- FIRST TUESDAY OF THE MONTH - Lap the Field - After riding the first half of the ride together as a group, the red beacon will lead an optional chase group at a hard pace (around 4w/kg) and attempt to lap riders in the main bunch. Whilst the chase is occurring the main bunch will continue to ride with the yellow ride leader at the usual pace of around 2.5 w/kg. It’s up to you – try and keep up with the faster bunch in red, or ride steady with yellow! In both cases, please try to stick with your chosen bunch.

- All OTHER WEEKS - Standard Short Race Format - Our final few kilometers will be an optional race to the end. The ride leader will let you know the exact start point in plenty of time.
Join our Zwift club to keep in touch with upcoming rides, chat with other participants outside the ride time, or if you'd like to get involved in running the ride! Search for "Friends of Escape Collective" in Zwift Companion's clubs interface.

name: VO2sday Micro Race (1 of 5) by Zwift Insider
description:
Welcome to VO2sday - 5 short, back-to-back TT races designed to give you a properly structured VO2 Max workout in a motivating and engaging race!

RESULTS: Final race results combining all 5 events can be found at https://leadoutesports.com/vo2sday/. 

IMPORTANT: You need to create an account at Leadout and link it to your Zwift account to show up in race results.

All races are 4 minutes long. Whoever rides the furthest, wins! Be sure to complete all 5 races so you get a full workout and are included in the overall competition.

Because the goal is for you to hold your max power for the duration of each race, these are set up as mass-start time trial events. Drafting is disabled, so there's no 'sitting in.' Use the best TT frame and wheels you've got. Push as hard as you can for the race duration, then recover and do it again!

Categories are based on your compound score, which takes into account your 5-minute power and body weight, computed as (5-min power in W/kg) * (5-min power in W). Current category setup:

- A: 1600+
- B: 1200-1600
- C: 900-1200
- D: 900 and below
